questions.question: Which planet has the most moons confirmed so far?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently leads the count, with more than 140 confirmed moons.

questions.question: What is the only mammal capable of true, sustained flight?
questions.explanation: Bats are the only mammals that can power their own sustained flight. The others glide.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for the element gold?
questions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word for gold, aurum.

questions.question: Which is the world's largest desert?
questions.explanation: Antarctica is a polar desert: it receives very little precipitation and is the largest desert on Earth.

questions.question: What is the fastest land animal?
questions.explanation: A cheetah can sprint at around 100 km/h (60 mph) over short distances.

questions.question: Which part of the human body has the smallest bones?
questions.explanation: The three tiny bones in the middle ear transmit sound vibrations. The stapes is the smallest bone in the body.
